articles.title: Is AI Music Losing Its Groove? Kids Are Hitting 'Skip'
articles.summary: A new report shows more and more listeners—especially kids and teens—are feeling uneasy about AI-made songs. On streaming platforms, AI tracks make up 44% of daily uploads but less than 3% of real streams. Even some big artists are speaking out.

articles.title: Pokémon Fossils Come to Life at a Real Museum!
articles.summary: The Pokémon Fossil Museum is traveling from Japan to Chicago's Field Museum! You can see real dinosaur bones next to life-sized Pokémon figures, including SUE the T. rex. It opens May 22, 2026, and runs for almost a year.

articles.title: Sinner Smashes Tennis Record with 5 Straight Big Wins!
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner just became the first man to win five Masters 1000 titles in a row! He beat Alexander Zverev 6-1, 6-2 in Madrid in only 58 minutes. The 24-year-old Italian hasn't lost a match in 23 games.
